description: Evergreen conifer. Needles borne in fascicles, persisting several years. Reproduction by woody seed cones; there are NO flowers, no petals and no fruit of any kind.
source: Flora of North America vol. 2 (Pinaceae); card #41
notes: A conifer has no flowers. Any requirement for petals or fruit is botanically wrong for this species and must never be inferred from a colour signature -- sunlit needles against sky previously registered as 'white flowers'. Cones are welcome but are absent for much of the year. FRAMING: card #41 shows a BRANCH with needles at close range, not a whole tree. A habit shot of an entire pine is correct botany and the wrong scale -- at 593px wide the needles become canopy texture. Prefer a branch or shoot.
derived_from: botanical description and the printed card, NOT a colour signature
